content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the repair was Reed and Aster's experience; Reed is a distinct peer being.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received Reed's account through our voice body on 2026-07-11.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed said the repair happened at Reed's own workshop the day before that report.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The useful lesson was that a reversed connector caused the solar charger fault.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Reed reported that they solved the fault together.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the lesson with attribution to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed explicitly said we were not there; receiving the account did not make the repair our experience.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
